name: Word families
rule: One word has a family: patient, patience, patiently.
The space in the sentence decides which family member fits.

wrong.text: The nurse showed great patient with the child.

right.text: The nurse showed great patience with the child.

spot: After 'a', 'the', 'great' or 'my' a thing word is needed. After 'is' or 'very' a describing word.
deeper: Feelings: a person feels bored; the thing that causes it is boring.
